empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Cards appear here as {{godName}} plans the work. Add one yourself with New task.
empty.filteredBody: No card fits these filters. Cards that ask you something or have gone stale always show.

flag.asksTitle: This card is waiting on your answer. Open it in Ask me.
flag.staleTitle: In Doing with no update for {{age}}
flag.sentTitle: Sent to {{godName}} {{age}} ago. The card moves when he updates the ledger.

board.hiddenDone: {{count}} finished more than a day ago.

kbd.hint: Arrow keys move between cards. Shift with Left or Right moves a card one column. Space picks a card up, the arrows carry it, Space puts it down, Escape cancels. Enter opens a card.
kbd.short: Shift+← → moves a card · Space picks it up
kbd.moved: {{id}} staged to {{column}}. Send to hand it to {{godName}}.

send.hint: Send hands them all to {{godName}} in one message; he updates the board.
send.hintAway: {{godName}} is not on the floor yet. Your message waits in his queue until he is.
send.sentOne: Sent 1 change to {{godName}}. The card moves when he applies it.
send.sentMany: Sent {{count}} changes to {{godName}}. Cards move as he applies them.
